title: I think I may have gone to mall world last night
content: I walked into one of the stores that was tiled ceiling to floor in small blue tiles with a cashier stand in the middle. I checked in with her and then sat at a small desk that folded to cover you up a bit. I bathed with soap there that smelled pretty good and I was glad to have washed myself clean. I knew I was going this to head over to a hot tub from there but dont remember much of that. I walk outside the store and start waiting for a subway inside the mall and was inappropriately touched by a man…. Sorry tmi.. anyone ever experience this at mall world
